task.title: Wire immutable failure generations from real supervisor records
task.phase: Supervisor Retry V3 / 1 Failure Record Wiring

scope.owned_layer: Exact V3 failure-streak aggregate and immutable generation schema, fail-closed decoding, canonical dispatch identity capture, and all six production recorder call sites.
scope.not_changing: Retry eligibility and thresholds, provider readiness, failure classification, progress extraction, configuration, product task materialization, and live services.

contract.generation_id: sha256 over canonical immutable evidence; count and recorded_at are excluded
contract.rejected_head_contract: exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters or ABSENT
contract.decoder_posture: exact-key, exact-version, canonical-value, timestamp, hash, aggregate-pointer, uniqueness, and count validation; legacy aliases fail closed
contract.deduplication: stable generation identity is searched across the complete streak; replay does not increment count or mutate the record
contract.distinctness: kind, reason class, reason, raw reference, rejected head, canonical task identity, provider, or worker-run changes create a distinct generation

acceptance.decoder_deny_matrix: proven by missing-field, malformed-field, unknown-alias, invalid-head, invalid-hash, duplicate-generation, and aggregate-pointer subtests
acceptance.replay_identity: proven before and after clear/recreate with a different recorder timestamp
acceptance.distinct_evidence_uniqueness: proven for same-raw-ref failures with different kind, reason, or head
acceptance.unrelated_streak_non_interference: proven through replay and targeted clear
acceptance.canonical_owner_reviewer_capture: proven through dispatch-event to request-snapshot preservation and real boot-reconciliation records

verification.result: checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon provisioned and dependency imports verified

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py -k 'FailureStreakV3 or immediate_start_failure_captures_v3 or active_worker_failure_captures_v3 or generic_exit_captures_v3 or reconcile_runtime_retries_missing_owner_with_bounded_evidence or reconcile_runtime_uses_log_failure_for_missing_process_quota or reconcile_runtime_uses_log_failure_for_copilot_monthly_quota or failure_streaks_aggregate_dispatch_slots'
